name: Steam Builds (SteamCMD)
shortDescription: Tracks the latest Steam builds for each game branch using the unofficial steamcmd.net API.
description:
Tracks the latest branch builds of Steam products.
Build data comes from the unofficial steamcmd.net API, so this is prone to breaking.
This plugin cannot search for games. Enable another Steam store plugin to search; without one, products can only be added by ID or URL.
